title: Term Life Insurance Waiver of Premium Benefit
content:
**Rider provision.** When the waiver of premium rider is attached to a Term Life Insurance policy and the insured becomes totally disabled before the policy anniversary at the product's waiver rider expiry age, installments falling due on or after the disability onset date are waived while total disability continues.

**Elimination period.** A waiver is applied only when the claim decision date is not earlier than the disability onset date plus the product's elimination period in months. The elimination end is found by adding the number of calendar months to the disability onset date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; a decision dated on the elimination end qualifies. Both dates are read from the waiver of premium claim.

**Approval.** Premiums are waived only under a waiver of premium claim whose request status is approved.

**Once only.** Each installment is waived at most once: an installment already carrying a waiver entry for its due date is not waived again.

**Refund.** Where the product refunds elimination-period premiums (every tier does), installments with due dates on or after the onset date that the owner already paid are refunded.

**Limits.** A disability that begins after the rider's expiry anniversary is not covered, and waiving premiums never extends the conversion deadline.

| Onset date (hypothetical) | Elimination period | Elimination end | Decision dated on the end | Decision the day before |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 August 2025 | 6 months | 28 February 2026 | qualifies | does not qualify |
| 15 January 2026 | 6 months | 15 July 2026 | qualifies | does not qualify |
